options.name: certname
options.description: The name to use when handling certificates.

options.name: confdir
options.description: Path to the directory containing the puppet.conf file.

options.name: debug
options.description: Enable full debugging.

options.name: environment
options.description: Puppet environment to be used.

options.name: environment_lang
options.description: The lang environment to use when running the puppet agent. The default value, V(C), is supported on every system, but can lead to encoding errors if UTF-8 is used in the output. Use V(C.UTF-8) or V(en_US.UTF-8) or similar UTF-8 supporting locales in case of problems. You need to make sure the selected locale is supported on the system the puppet agent runs on. Starting with community.general 9.1.0, you can use the value V(auto) and the module tries to determine the best parseable locale to use.

options.name: execute
options.description: Execute a specific piece of Puppet code. It has no effect with a puppetmaster.

options.name: facter_basename
options.description: Basename of the facter output file.

options.name: facts
options.description: A dict of values to pass in as persistent external facter facts.

options.name: logdest
options.description: Where the puppet logs should go, if puppet apply is being used. V(all) goes to both C(console) and C(syslog). V(stdout) is deprecated and replaced by C(console).

options.name: manifest
options.description: Path to the manifest file to run puppet apply on.

options.name: modulepath
options.description: Path to an alternate location for puppet modules.

options.name: noop
options.description: Override puppet.conf noop mode. When V(true), run Puppet agent with C(--noop) switch set. When V(false), run Puppet agent with C(--no-noop) switch set. When unset (default), use default or puppet.conf value if defined.

options.name: puppetmaster
options.description: The hostname of the puppetmaster to contact.

options.name: show_diff
options.description: Whether to print file changes details.

options.name: skip_tags
options.description: A list of puppet tags to be excluded.

options.name: summarize
options.description: Whether to print a transaction summary.

options.name: tags
options.description: A list of puppet tags to be used.

options.name: timeout
options.description: How long to wait for C(puppet) to finish. This parameter is deprecated and will be removed in community.general 14.0.0. Use the task-level C(timeout) keyword instead. To suppress this deprecation warning, set O(timeout) to V("").

options.name: use_srv_records
options.description: Toggles use_srv_records flag.

options.name: verbose
options.description: Print extra information.

options.name: waitforlock
options.description: The maximum amount of time C(puppet) should wait for an already running C(puppet) agent to finish before starting. If a number without unit is provided, it is assumed to be a number of seconds. Allowed units are V(m) for minutes and V(h) for hours.
